name: Tractor (Sheng Ji)
description: Tractor (拖拉机 Tuō Lā Jī), also known as Sheng Ji (升级, 'Level Up'), is one of the most popular card games in China. It is a 4-player partnership trick-taking game using two standard decks (108 cards). The unique feature is a dynamic trump system where the trump rank changes as teams 'level up' from 2 through Ace. Point cards are K=10, 10=10, 5=5.

history.origins: Tractor (Sheng Ji) evolved in China from the older single-deck point-trick game known as sishi fen (40 points), expanding to two or more decks. It belongs to the Sheng Ji (upgrade) family with zhao pengyou (finding friends). By the late 20th century it had become the most widely played card game in mainland China, especially in Shanghai and south of the Yellow River, where it largely displaced the older single-deck form. Played across China and in Chinese diaspora communities with regional rule variation.
timeline: 1960s–1980s: Tractor (Sheng Ji) developed in China from single-deck point-trick games.
Late 20th century: Becomes the most widespread card game in mainland China; regional variants spread.
Present: Played across China and in Chinese diaspora communities with many house rules.
history.cultural: The most widespread card game in mainland China.
history.evolution: Many regional variants. Core mechanic (leveling up) is universal.

setup.deck: 108 cards (2 standard decks with Jokers). Point cards: K=10, 10=10, 5=5. Total 200 points.
setup.dealing: Deal 25 each. 8 to Kitty. Declarer takes Kitty, discards 8.

rules.objective: Attackers try to score 80+ points. Defenders try to prevent it. Winners level up.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal while declaring trump suit (show trump rank card). 2. Declarer takes 8-card Kitty, discards 8. 3. Play tricks: Lead single, pair, or 'Tractor' (consecutive pairs). Follow suit/structure. Trump if void. 4. Last trick: Kitty points doubled to attackers. 5. Score 200 total points. Attackers need 80+.
keyRules: Kitty points doubled on last trick

strategy.basic: Control trumps. Don't give away 10s and Ks in losing tricks. Protect the Kitty.
strategy.intermediate: Use Tractors to sweep tricks. Void a suit to trump effectively.
strategy.advanced: Calculate remaining trumps. Manipulate the Kitty for maximum defense. Coordinate with partner.
tips: The trump rank card in trump suit is second-highest.
Level up faster by winning big.

variations.name: Game with three decks
variations.description: Three decks and six jokers. Each player draws 39 cards; starter takes 6 and discards 6. 300 points; opponents need 120+ to become declarers. Triples and tractors of triples allowed.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant changes deck count and kitty size; engine constants for these are not yet modeled in overrides.

variations.name: 20 points per rank
variations.description: Each 20 points (rather than 40) increases the winners' score by one rank. Opponents still need 80 to become declarers; 100-115 they also gain a rank, etc.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant changes rank-advancement thresholds; source does not specify engine constant overrides.

variations.name: Short game
variations.description: Play until a team reaches a lower rank (e.g. seven) or start at a higher rank (e.g. seven) instead of two to shorten play.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant shortens game by changing start or end rank; engine overrides for optimal_players or rank range not yet modeled.
